description: Start watching a URL for changes. The server stores a snapshot, re-fetches on your interval, and reports a unified diff when the extracted text changes. Use this when you need to know if something changed since last time - an ordinary fetch cannot tell you that. Selector forms: css:#id, css:.class, css:tag, regex:PATTERN, json:$.path, or empty for whole body text.

selector.description: What part to compare, e.g. css:#price or json:$.status. Empty = whole page text.

name: watch_create
